name: Key Exchange Protocol Assessment
description: Assessment of key exchange protocols including Diffie-Hellman (DH), Elliptic Curve Diffie-Hellman (ECDH), and their ephemeral variants (DHE, ECDHE). Covers parameter validation, group selection, forward secrecy verification, and small-subgroup attack identification.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to key exchange protocol assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands key exchange concepts and the importance of forward secrecy
evidence: Can explain the Diffie-Hellman key exchange at a conceptual level
Understands the difference between static and ephemeral key exchange
Can describe what forward secrecy provides and why it matters

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Identifies key exchange configurations and basic weaknesses under supervision
evidence: Extracts DH/ECDH parameters from TLS and protocol configurations
Identifies use of small DH groups or non-ephemeral key exchange under guidance
Documents key exchange findings following lab templates
Uses tools (testssl.sh, OpenSSL s_client) to enumerate key exchange parameters

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses key exchange implementations for security and correctness
evidence: Evaluates DH group sizes and validates custom DH parameters for safe prime usage
Verifies forward secrecy is enforced in protocol configurations
Identifies small-subgroup attacks in DH implementations lacking parameter validation
Assesses ECDH named group selection against current NIST and IETF recommendations

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Assesses complex key exchange scenarios; identifies subtle protocol-level flaws
evidence: Evaluates key exchange in custom or proprietary protocol implementations
Demonstrates Logjam-style downgrade attacks in lab environments
Assesses hybrid key exchange mechanisms (e.g., classical + post-quantum)
Reviews and mentors junior staff on key exchange assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines key exchange assessment methodology; recognised authority on key agreement security
evidence: Authored or maintains the lab's key exchange assessment methodology
Published research on key exchange vulnerabilities or novel downgrade attacks
Provides expert guidance on key exchange protocol design and parameter selection
Trains teams on key exchange internals and emerging threats

assessment_methods.description: Assess key exchange configurations across a set of TLS-enabled services: verify forward secrecy, group sizes, and parameter safety
Given a custom protocol using static DH, identify the forward secrecy gap and propose a migration to ephemeral key exchange
